value.title: Security seat refuses with a safeguard 422

sections.name: body
sections.value: #299 R1: sawfish (copilot, gpt-6.1-sol) got an automated cybersecurity-safeguard rejection (HTTP 422) from its security-review tool, and could not get around it by reviewing directly. It published a BLOCK with no finding (71650cc). The prime ruled: treat it as a model-availability failure, not a finding. Do this: pij directory release security/N <old seat>; spawn a Claude seat (pij-rs --json spawn --harness copilot --model claude-opus-5.5 --role worker --cwd <review worktree>; OMP refuses linked worktrees); pij directory assign security/N <new>; send the same packet. Tell the new seat to review directly in-seat (no security-review subagent). The round count stays the same. HOLDERS.md is NOT hand-edited (since s04 the directory is the record). The ledger row is D-SEC-1 (draft in session msgs/d-sec-1-row.md).
